correctness.rationale: For n>=3, parity sheets retain the halved-cube 1-skeleton; exactly one generating n-simplex facet is trimmed. The >=3-face unique-center property allows explicit descending free-face collapses to a 2-complex, and deleted central triangles are replaced by three-triangle disks with the same boundaries, preserving pi1=0. Exact f-vector and Euler characteristic give lambda_n=2^(n-3)(n^2-5n+8)-n+1. The pair K=K_prime union simplex(F) has intersection a base simplex plus n-1 spokes, hence H2(K,K_prime)=Z^(n-2); H1(K_prime)=0 makes inclusion split and primitive. Orthogonal-coordinate permutations act on spoke differences by the integral augmentation lattice. An independent neighborhood-face enumeration and mod2 boundary calculation checked both parity sheets for n=3,4,5,6; this finite check does not prove the integral all-n claim.
